svg.title: Figure 2.1: Census descent: N after each step, coloured by rule
svg.desc: The census descent of seed 7101 (40 twists), rounds 1 and 2: N after each of its 97 steps, coloured by rule
svg.text: Figure 2.1: Census descent: N after each step, coloured by rule
Round 1 ends after step 89; round 2's cumulative record ends after step 97. Every point is a census step, not a runner step. The
two rounds are not concatenated twice.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
